RequiredText.ts holds one validation rule, requireText, and it reports failures through the module's own ValidationError instead of a plain Error. So it uses the module's abstraction and doesn't go around it. The non-empty text rule exists only in requireText, and the error-naming behaviour exists only in DomainError's constructor. Neither rule is duplicated. The incoming edges show that Project, Task and User import requireText instead of writing their own copy. The two files don't split into unrelated concerns: both are shared domain building blocks, and one depends on the other.
